theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_ll_tangent_wedge_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U (n + 1)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (B : ℝ), Continuous ω → (∀ x, ‖ω x‖ ≤ B) → ∃ (W : Euclid P → Euclid P) (c' : ℝ), Measurable W ∧ (∀ x, ω x = 0 → W x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, ‖W x‖ ≤ c') ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict R.carrier), W x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) R.carrier x ∧ ∀ β : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ, R.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (β.smulRight (ω x))) = β (W x)
